vehicle_ck_plate_code_subtype.name: vehicle_ck_plate_code_subtype
vehicle_ck_plate_code_subtype.value: (("vehicle"."plate_code" = '03' AND "vehicle"."plate_code_subtype" IS NOT NULL) OR ("vehicle"."plate_code" <> '03' AND "vehicle"."plate_code_subtype" IS NULL))

vehicle_ck_tin_required.name: vehicle_ck_tin_required
vehicle_ck_tin_required.value: (NOT ("vehicle"."plate_code" = '01' OR ("vehicle"."plate_code" = '03' AND "vehicle"."plate_code_subtype" = 'transport_service')) OR NULLIF(BTRIM("vehicle"."tin_number"), '') IS NOT NULL)
